recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Any cleanup of stale examples or search parameters that still mention plannedActivityDetail should be handled under the already represented FHIR-39101 change family rather than under FHIR-6944.
issue_request: FHIR-6944 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for DSTU1 CarePlan. It requested changing CarePlan.Activity.detail.reason from 0..1 to repeatable reasonCode and reasonCondition elements so an activity could have multiple reasons.
initial_application: The Jira comment records SVN #6766 as the original application. Local git history has no explicit FHIR-6944 commit, but the earliest available imported CarePlan source in c69d71aa already had CarePlan.activity.detail.reasonCode and CarePlan.activity.detail.reasonReference with max="*", preserving the approved repeatable coded and resource-backed reason model under later element naming.
additional_context: CarePlan is active in source/fhir.ini. Later Patient Care decisions changed the model: FHIR-26064 renamed activity.detail to plannedActivityDetail, and FHIR-39101 removed plannedActivityDetail from the active CarePlan model in favor of plannedActivityReference. The current XML keeps the old plannedActivityDetail subtree inside an XML comment, where the retained reason child is also max="*", but namespace-aware parsing of active ElementDefinitions shows no active CarePlan.activity reason path. FHIR-39101 already has an issue-reconcile commit on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. An empty no-change audit commit was published to record that the seed request needs no current source correction.
